query:
-- Lock the manually corrected March 29 attendance records
UPDATE attendance_weekly SET manualLock = true 
WHERE weekStartDate = '2026-03-29' AND campus IN ('Canton', 'Jasper');

-- Lock the manually corrected March 29 giving record
UPDATE giving_weekly SET manualLock = true 
WHERE weekStartDate = '2026-03-29' AND campus = 'All Campuses';

-- Verify
SELECT 'attendance' as tbl, weekStartDate, campus, headcount, manualLock 
FROM attendance_weekly WHERE manualLock = true
UNION ALL
SELECT 'giving', weekStartDate, campus, total, manualLock 
FROM giving_weekly WHERE manualLock = true
